title: Range Upgrade, New Items, Inv Space+ , Corruption Fix & More! - RuneScape Dragonwilds News & Updates

transcript.text: Hello folks, we do have some exciting news for Dragon Wilds today as just a few hours ago the much anticipated first
Luminance update 1.0.1 did just arrive bringing along some new content in the form of reworked ranged combat, jumping
attacks, separate slots for both rings and amulets, increased inventory space from 32 to 40 slots along with plenty
more additions, quality of life and bug fixes. In addition to this, we have complete fixes for the two remaining
save corruption issues as well as a range of console specific improvements like key binding, inventory sorting,
etc. Plenty for us to get through and as usual we are not wasting any time, so let's get started.
Okay, so the update and patch notes themselves dropped just mere hours ago. It is of course live on all platforms
already and it does go as follows. The big headline for this one is a range of fixes targeting the disappearing world
saves that we've seen reported as well as a catch up mechanic for corrupted character saves that will let you drop
in with aggregated stats and tier four gear to get you back in the fight. Hop in and give those a try, but we're aware
that there may still be the occasional player affected by other extraneous instances of save issues that we're
still collecting data on. We're talking about very, very small numbers of affected players, but it matters all the
same. Beyond that, let's get into what else is coming in the 1.0.1 update. Now, very quickly we've covered the save
corruption issues in the weekly Dragon Wilds videos already. The first which occurred all the way back at console
launch has now received its fix in which any players affected will be given these
following stats and tier four equipment to help catch them back up to the point of progression before corruption. And
then for the most recent issue of worlds seemingly disappearing from the server list, previously the issue was addressed
in that it shouldn't occur for any more players moving forward, but now it appears we have a full fix and lost
worlds should have reappeared for those who were affected. In all honesty, these patch notes are a little bit light on
the actual specifics, but do let me know below how you're getting on as I'd really like to know if all of these
issues have now been fully resolved. Anyway, the rest of the patch notes do go on to say, "1.0.1 and core
improvements. Unlock the skill tree perk, Death from Above. Anytime you are slightly above the max height of the
double jump's arc from the ground, inputting an attack will plunge you downward to slam into unfortunate
victims below. Damage scales with the weapon you have equipped, so make sure you're holding something hefty before
you leap. And yes, wind step counts here. What goes up must come crashing down. Next, we have added the ranged
skill perk, ammo recovery, and its greater version later in the skill tree, greater ammo recovery. Adds a chance to
recover arrows from the bodies of slain enemies. Ranged weapon subclasses are receiving their own special attack
variants to make them feel more aligned with the fantasy of using the short bow, long bow, or crossbow. For the short
bow, we have rapid fire, hop backwards and fire off three arrows in quick succession. The target can be switched
between this volley of shots to spread the damage. For the long bow, we have power shot, take a knee to draw an arrow
at full strength, let fly to loose a staggering, enormously powerful shot at great distance. Next, we have the
crossbow, heavy bow, rack a bow and let it fly after a short charge. Hits like Asgardian ale on an empty stomach and
applies enchanted effects on hit. And then finally, we have introduced the low blow skill perk, ranged attacks that hit
the enemy in the legs, lower third of the body or their legs, applies hamstring, which reduces enemy movement
speed for a short while. Tiny and colossal enemies are immune. Now, as I have said in multiple previous videos,
we were expecting some reworks to ranged combat given that melee was in a really good place already and magic combat has
received some additional love with wands being included in the 1.0 update. What we actually have is two versions of an
ammo recovery skill, which will improve the sustainability of using ranged. We also have special attacks included for
all three ranged weapon types, which should increase DPS and general damage across the board. And then finally, with
being able to reduce the movement speed of some enemies with the low blow skill perk, not becoming surrounded or certain
1 v 1s should be somewhat easier. Of course, with this update dropping just mere hours ago, I haven't had chance to
jump and test out the new skills just yet, but by the sound of things, ranged combat should now be a little bit more
on par with both other combat styles. And of course, we can also expect other changes, tweaks, and additions to all
three of them over the foreseeable future as the devs have said they're not done improving on things and it's more
just a case of steadily building upon combat over a long period of time, which is basically exactly what we've seen
happen ever since the game entered early access just over a year and a half ago, at which point only melee combat
existed. Anyway, there's still plenty for us to get through and so the rest of the patch notes do go as follows.
Increased inventory space from 32 to 40. Added a toggle for the visceral attack camera change. Fixed an issue where
users on mounts could not open the map correctly. Obstacles and enemies now respawn in the Scorned Wilderness Raid
on reset/next run-through. Reduced aggro range for enemies across the game to prevent forming a bit of a follow train
like a folly drop party. Enemy mob respawn timers extended so they stay dead for longer as you clear areas.
Fixed an issue where users on controller were unable to sort chests without free LS correctly. Polish pass on mining
nodes across the world to ensure they're all above ground and can be mined. Goblin barks, ambient noises they make,
should now sound less like they've just seen you and that they're yelling. Improvements on the sort functionality,
weight, type, and latest. For the weight, we have cumulative stack weight and heaviest first. For type, we have
categories of items and alphabetical. And then for latest, we have the most recently picked up items first. Next, we
have added a dedicated ring and amulet slot. Thanks to Furnax, Negan TWD, Cloud None, and others who suggested this. The
amulet of glory was providing additional bonuses above what was initially intended, so we're tapping those numbers
back down to better align with what we wanted it to be. We're adding the ultra compost bin because super just wasn't
cutting it anymore and we're adding a large compost bucket which has a larger capacity. Adding a completed quest tab
including a short summary of the outcome of the quest. Overdrive can now be cast on the advanced spinning wheel. Rune
arrows and bolts now do more damage than adamant, 4.9x versus 4.2x. The fishing cape now correctly displays the skill
cape perk, you have a small chance to instantly catch a fish. And then finally, remove the ability to rebind
keybinds for settings that could softlock the player in certain instances. For interaction, we have
removed spell. For building, we have cancel building and quick interact. For crafting, we have the crafting tab left
and right. And then finally, for quest dialogue, we have continue conversation, cancel conversation, and then select
answers one through two four. Now, I won't take too long here, but some of the new fixes and additions I'm very
happy to see would be the following. Firstly, the increase from 32 to 40 inventory space was reported on Reddit
by a fan in attendance at the recent RuneFest event. The Q&A in which this was mentioned has not been live-streamed
or otherwise made public outside of RuneFest, and so based on just that one fan's reports, they were absolutely
right. And seemingly, we have this addition already. What's quite exciting about this is the same fan also reported
the dev saying they were adding additional summoning options to the game. And now that the first report has
become true, it does suggest this second report will then become true, too. It's important to note that the devs are not
referring to the actual summoning skill from other RuneScape games, but instead just the summoning that already exists
within Dragon wilds already, like magical spells and the farro scepter. We've no idea when these will arrive,
but alas, they are all but confirmed to be arriving sometime in the future. Other additions I'm then very happy to
see would be things like now being able to sort inventory on controller, the addition of both a ring and amulet slot
instead of just one accessory slot, and then enemy aggro has been toned down, along with respawn rate, which should
make the general ebb and flow of the game a little more tolerable when exploring lesser areas. Anyway, the
final part of the patch notes touches on additional bug fixes, and so they do go as follows. Fixed an issue where users
could clip through the floor when teleporting to Cataclysm Keep from Commander Zilyana. Resolved an issue
where PlayStation 5 users were unable to see the assigned sort button on chests. Resolved an issue where players who had
acquired quest items early through multiplayer sessions would be unable to progress to the next region. E.g.
Amarok's head prevented the player from entering Val Hollow, etc. Resolved an issue where users could crash when
selecting online play whilst being offline. Fixed an issue where rain could cause visual effects to be visible
inside player housing at any graphical setting. It no longer rains indoors. Resolved an issue where sanguine urns
within the radius of the Scorned Wilderness were not displaying correctly. Resolved an issue where the
skills page description states magic focus can be crafted at the crafting table instead of the blacksmith's bench.
Fixed an issue where images in the journal could scale incorrectly. Begone giant bandeau symbol. Fixed an issue
where hosts would unlock achievements triggered by a player in the world. Resolved the bug causing ascension cores
to not drop from Kol Dra in some circumstances. Fixed an issue where users with emojis in their name on PC
would not be able to join PlayStation 5 or Xbox player hosted worlds. Fixed the dragon medium helm icon to be the right
shade of red. So so sorry. All platforms can now access the UI scaling option as intended. Special attacks from ranged
will now trigger gamepad vibration as intended. Fixed an issue where maple sap would not be removed from the inventory
on death. Sticky stuff. Resolved an issue where the VFX on the title screen was offset incorrectly. Fixed an issue
where D-pad navigation in the chest inventory UI would not work in certain circumstances. Fixed an issue where map
fog would not be cleared when entering a new area after being on an agility course. Resolved an issue where HP would
fail to regen at the stated rate in certain conditions. Fixed an issue where users were unable to navigate the skills
menu via mouse clicks the first time in a session. Resolved an issue where users could hear Kol Dra from the Saradomin
Temple if another player was in the raid. Fixed an issue where reward chests would play default open SFX. Fixed a bug
where Titan's Wrath would set the player on fire if the special attack was used in rapid succession. Fixed the bug where
Fusan would become passive if a player died in certain circumstances, essentially becoming invincible. Fixed
incomplete waterfall VFX in the fractured planes. Fixed an issue where the inventory being opened would not
show tool tips on Xbox or PC. Fixed inconsistent cursor navigation within the building UI. Fixed an issue where
users on dedicated servers could not place foundation or floor pieces if one had been previously destroyed there.
Fixed an issue where the Gilded Guyahawk amulet would not unlock upon completion of all gold times. Fixed an issue where
keyboards would freeze after any form of teleport, vault entry or exit, loadstone
or cabbit burrow. Resolved an Epic Games store issue where users would not be able to view dedicated servers even if
they had connected to them previously. Fixed an issue where emo and spell wheel would briefly flash up when opening the
spellbook. Fixed a short freeze when unmounting for the first time after launch. Fixed the Regicide achievement
which would not unlock after killing Coldra under certain circumstances. Fixed four Scorch and Witcherhood icons
being misaligned and Scorch displaying 999 after restarting the game with it maxed. Fixed four audio not triggering
combat music in Dawden Reach when fighting normal enemies. Fixed an issue where the Terrorbird's death audio would
play too late. Resolved an issue where Jagged X launcher users could claim multiple beds. Fixed the spot in
Emberwood in Fal Hollow where players could get stuck between two rocks and fall indefinitely. Resolved an issue
where freshly used cabbit burrow holes would appear uncleared. Resolved an issue where when opening the map, the
map open SFX would get cut off before playing in full and then would not play on subsequent opens. Resolved an issue
where players would not be able to open the build menu whilst the build information pop up was still visible.
Resolved an issue where the Infebble spell would not effectively reduce damage across all enemy types. Resolved
an issue where becoming withered in Fal Hollow would cause foliage to move very quickly. Fixed an issue where placing
the personal chest item around specific items would cause a large game hitch / freeze. Fixed an issue where weather
curse would apply in inaccurate locations within Hope's Fall. Fixed an issue where the Scorned Wilderness
Dalden Reach the Umbral Sands journal entries in journal knowledge places weren't showing. Fixed an issue where
users on a dedicated server would not register properly if another client had been reset by position or death. Fixed
an issue where the divine rock cool down is incorrectly set to 1,500 seconds instead of 1,800 seconds. Fixed an issue
where superheat would display placeholder text when used without a valid target. Fixed an issue where water
magic wand projectiles would not be visible on multiplayer worlds unless very close. Fixed an issue where air
magic attacks visually travel further than their effective range. Fixed an issue where the Dalden Reach Nexus would
have flickering VFX when viewed from outside. Fixed an issue where clients on older worlds see the sanguine urn in
Frankenstein's castle in a different place and may not be able to interact with it. Resolved an issue where
attempting to use multiple consumable items simultaneously would trigger a constant item cool down overlay under
item toolbar. Fixed the rune spade so it isn't upside down in the weapons rack. Fixed an issue where the Zogar lock on
point was too high on the model so the camera was unwieldy in melee range. Fixed an issue where the artisan and
construction scape effects were not triggering on use, repairing and building respectively. Gebbit burrows
should now be correctly labeled. Fixed an issue where green dragons could get caught on the edge of the Al-Kharid
Oasis instance area. Overall polish pass on green dragons after reports of stuttering / clipping at certain angles.
Resolved an issue where the coldra interior section would prevent users from using camera lock on on targets
within. Resolved an issue where in Al-Kharid's camp reputation was not gradually progressing but rather would
jump to level four once all quests were completed. Resolved an issue where sorting servers would return
inconsistent results. Resolved an issue where potted plant decorations would move when walked over when on place
terrain and would move with the wind when placed outside. Resolved an issue where agility courses were always
discovered with the map region. The icons for the courses will now appear on the map when a player gets close to
them. Resolved an issue where some food had power levels. Level up VFX {slash} sparkles no longer decoupled from the
player if you level up whilst running. Humidify can now hit the same amount of you plots as over farming plots.
Resolved an issue where sworn servant special attack on the Pharaoh's Scepter did not show its costs. Fixed an issue
where the blue dragon would take inaccurate damage when fought from different heights. Fixed an issue where
lowering the black dragon to a safe spot would cause performance drops on some hardware. Resolved an issue where
Vel'gath's poison breath attack had misaligned VFX on PlayStation 5 systems. Fixed an issue where light was emitted
from the final puzzle before Culdra as if they were active when they weren't. Fixed a bug which caused some enemies to
be unaffected by the enchanted iron bolt effect when hit. Fixed an issue where the background of the runecrafting
mini-game would distort on Switch 2 systems. Fixed an issue where the processing station tooltip would be cut
off if scaling was set to 1.25x on Switch 2 systems. Fixed an issue where ores would respawn instantly when
teleporting in the Scorned Wilderness Raid. Resolved an issue which caused repeated fevering block and attack to
spam attacks before unlocking the level 23 attack perk. Fixed an issue where adding multiple items to a crafting
station would force the user to re-navigate to the inventory. Fixed several win step related skips in the
Scorned Wilderness Raid. Resolved an issue where the ingredient requirements would not reset to default when less
than the designated amount was available during wood crafting. Resolved an issue where clients in a multiplayer world
wouldn't be able to see the host holding a Pharaoh's Scepter. Fixed an issue where actual projection would only
highlight the first tree in range when playing on a dedicated server. Resolved an issue where the strike to achievement
would not trigger in some circumstances. Fixed an issue where Fuzan would briefly appear to get back up before dying for
real this time. Fixed an issue where pausing and tabbing out of the game in Dungeoneering Reach would cause the
ambient noise to grow louder over time. Resolved an issue where controller action direction fails to affect
blocking input. Fixed an issue where the abyssal snare attack would immediately explode when used on built floors. Fixed
an issue where the Black Knight Titans barrier in Dalden Reach was permeable to magic attacks in both directions.
Resolved an issue affecting bow drawing animations when crouched. Resolved an issue where the tannery could contain
free slots if removing and adding tanner's kit whilst the tannery is full. And then finally, fixed an issue where
if the player exits to menu during the Valgar boss fight, the Dragonkin altar would reset to original position. Our
commitment to you is clear. Dragon wilds is the third pillar of the Runescape series and one we will continue to
support throughout the years to come. The road map we have for 2027 and the blood crystal saga is one we're deeply
proud of and one that we're excited to build with you update after update. For now, be good and we'll see you in Ashen
fall. Now, that was an absolute ton of fixes and so I won't bog down this video by talking about them all that much. I
am very happy to see just so much addressed within this first major update since the console launch though and I
feel this update as a whole is a very good sign of things to come. 1.0.1 is actually the first of three luminants
updates which arrive between now and the end of the year. November's update should be of a similar caliber to this
one but then December's update will be much bigger and likely include the vast majority of all of the content shown off
for the luminants updates already. With the 2027 road map then already outlined and with it following the same pattern
as what we're currently experiencing, we can now basically expect an update like
today's at least once per month for over the next year or so and then every three
months it will actually be a much larger update which contains tons of new content. This is obviously fantastic
news as players can keep returning every month for at least the next year or so and who knows where things go beyond
2027. Hopefully we can expect this post development cycle for a very long time to come but of course and as always, we
will just have to wait and see. Now, I'll continue to keep my eyes peeled on any more developments and they'll likely
be covered in the next Dragon Wilds weekly video either this week or next. Bigger topics will get individual videos
themselves, but generally all things will be covered multiple times here and there so as to get the news into as many
hands as possible. That is then also to say that do of course feel free to treat this channel as your one-stop spot for
all things RuneScape Dragon Wilds moving forward. Anyway, that would be it for this one, folks. I'll be back soon with
plenty more and I do of course have a range of guide and news videos on the channel already, so do feel free to stop
on by [music] and check things out. Otherwise, thanks for watching, folks, and until next time. Peace.
>> [music] [music]
